name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in static frames better than any other free upscaler we’ve tested, giving us a measurable 0.7% quality bump on test sets. The trade-off is a 15% slowdown in upscaling speed, but since EXCAVA’s bottleneck is motion interpolation, not upscaling, the net gain is positive.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t touch EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a spatial fix, not temporal. Flowframes’ FILM upscaler won’t either; it interpolates, not reconstructs. Test a temporal model like RIFE or VFI-Flow on the same clips; if it gains 0.5%+ without breaking real-time, that’s the move.
